title: Tiger cub wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='#ffa733'/>

  <circle cx='61.5' cy='47.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <polygon points='47,55 53,55 50,59' fill='#ff5a8a'/>

  <path d='M50,59 Q45,64 42,61' stroke='#a83d00' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
